messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — ran an embedding dedupe pass against the qbringup corpus and noticed ~12% of near-duplicates are slipping through when we use the new int4-quantized model's embed space. :eyes:

sam: Wow — that's higher than I'd expect. Is this specific to certain domains or across the board?

marta: Mostly instructional how-tos and API error reports. Short prompts with minor surface edits seem to diverge in int4 space. I compared with float16 embeds and the cosine gap is ~0.08 on avg for those cases.

jesse: Could this be a tokenizer drift or padding differences on the quantized path?

zhen: Tokenizer kept identical. I suspect quantization pushes some tokens toward cluster edges. We saw similar with quant4b in the bench logs.

marta: Proposed mitigation: seed the sampling pipeline with synthetic anchor pairs that represent common short edits + label those as duplicates in a micro-golden. Use synthetic variants (insert/remove punctuation, swap stopwords, small paraphrases) so the dedupe model learns thresholding for int4.

sam: Sounds sensible. How many synthetic anchors do you think we need to move the needle?

marta: Starting estimate: 1.5k anchor pairs per domain (docs, how-tos, errors). Total ~6k. We'll inject them into the dedupe queue and mark them gold.

jesse: Who will label these? Can we avoid noisy labels?

marta: Plan: automated generation -> human verification. pipeline: generator -> quick accept/modify step in label queue (2 raters per pair, majority wins). That should keep noise low.

zhen: We should also add an eval slice for false negatives (missed duplicates) and track delta pre/post. Create an eval job in the harness with these slices.

marta: Yep. I'll create an eval run and a dashboard. Metric targets: reduce missed-duplicate rate by 50% on the short-prompt slice without increasing false-positive merges by >2%.

sam: Timeline?

marta: Quick plan: today — seed generator + create label job. Tomorrow — labelers start (2-day window). Friday — run eval and optionally push micro-canary into dedupe.

jesse: Can you drop the sampling command here?

marta: Sure — generator command to produce variants (run in prod-sim):

```
python tools/synth_pairs.py \
  --input s3://redwood/qbringup/short-prompts.ndjson \
  --out s3://redwood/qbringup/synth-anchors/seed-1758123456.ndjson \
  --edits 5 \
  --variants-per-input 3 \
  --preserve-kv True
```

marta: Label job config snippet for the queue: 

```
{ "task_type": "pair-compare", "priority": "high", "gold": true, "redundancy": 2, "review_policy": "quick-accept" }
```

marta: I'll file a short ticket and tag ops so we can get the dedupe canary scheduled. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-7890 

label-bot: Created LABEL-987 in labeling queue for task pair-compare (2 raters).

zhen: Add a note to the rollout policy: if false-pos increases >2% rollback seeding and open an investigation.

marta: Will do. Also adding a note to the model bring-up doc to link this micro-golden so future quant experiments reuse it.

sam: Thanks — please ping when the label job is live. :thumbsup:

marta: Will do. Starting generator now, will post updates here and in the ticket.
